name: President of Azerbaijan
description: Head of state and head of the executive branch of the Republic of Azerbaijan; elected by popular vote for a 7-year term.

name: Presidential Administration of Azerbaijan
description: The Office of the President; supports the President and coordinates the executive branch, including policy departments.

name: Cabinet of Ministers of Azerbaijan
description: Highest executive body of Azerbaijan, governing the ministries and other central executive bodies under the President.

name: National Assembly of Azerbaijan
description: Milli Majlis - unicameral legislature of Azerbaijan, 125 members elected for 5-year terms.

name: Supreme Assembly of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic
description: Highest legislative body of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, an exclave of Azerbaijan.

name: Constitutional Court of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Supreme body of constitutional justice; ensures the supremacy of the Constitution of Azerbaijan.

name: Supreme Court of Azerbaijan
description: Highest judicial body for civil, criminal and other cases; court of cassation instance.

name: Central Election Commission of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: State body administering elections and referendums in Azerbaijan.

name: Commissioner for Human Rights (Ombudsman) of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Ombudsman institution for the restoration of human rights and freedoms violated in Azerbaijan.

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Azerbaijan
description: Ministry responsible for the diplomatic relations of the Republic of Azerbaijan with other states.

name: Ministry of Defence of Azerbaijan
description: Government ministry responsible for military and national defense matters.

name: Ministry of Internal Affairs of Azerbaijan
description: Government ministry responsible for police, internal order and public security.

name: Ministry of Justice of Azerbaijan
description: Justice ministry of Azerbaijan responsible for the legal system, penalties and registers.

name: Ministry of Finance of Azerbaijan
description: Government ministry responsible for public finance, budget and treasury.

name: Ministry of Economy of Azerbaijan
description: Government body responsible for economic policy, business development and investment promotion.

name: Ministry of Energy of Azerbaijan
description: Ministry responsible for energy policy (oil, gas, electricity); Wikidata entity retains the former name Ministry of Industry and Energy.

name: Ministry of Healthcare of Azerbaijan
description: Government ministry responsible for public health and the healthcare system.

name: Ministry of Science and Education of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Ministry responsible for education and science policy.

name: Ministry of Culture of Azerbaijan
description: Ministry responsible for cultural policy and heritage.

name: Ministry of Digital Development and Transport of Azerbaijan
description: Ministry responsible for digital development, telecommunications and transport.

name: Ministry of Agriculture of Azerbaijan
description: Ministry responsible for agricultural policy.

name: Ministry of Ecology and Natural Resources of Azerbaijan
description: Government agency responsible for environmental protection and natural resources.

name: Ministry of Emergency Situations of Azerbaijan
description: Ministry responsible for civil defense and emergency management (FHN).

name: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection of Population of Azerbaijan
aliases: Əmək və Əhalinin Sosial Müdafiəsi Nazirliyi
description: Ministry responsible for labor, employment and social protection.

key_people.title: Minister of Labor and Social Protection
key_people.name: Anar Aliyev

name: Ministry of Youth and Sports of Azerbaijan
description: Ministry responsible for youth policy and sport.

name: Prosecutor General's Office of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Unified system of prosecution bodies headed by the Prosecutor General.

name: State Customs Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: State body responsible for customs control and foreign trade regulation.

name: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Azerbaijan's principal government institution in charge of statistics and census data.

name: State Migration Service of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Executive body responsible for migration policy, registration and work permits for foreigners.

name: ASAN Service
aliases: State Agency for Public Service and Social Innovations
description: State Agency for Public Service and Social Innovations - one-stop public service centers.

name: Media Development Agency of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: State regulatory body for media, established 2021 (replacing the Press Council's regulatory role).

name: Food Safety Agency of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: State agency regulating food safety (AFSA).

name: State Tourism Agency of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Executive body responsible for state policy and regulation in tourism.

name: Azerbaijan Investment Holding
description: Sovereign wealth holding under the President, managing state stakes in key enterprises (est. 2020).

name: Azerbaijan Export and Investment Promotion Foundation (AZPROMO)
description: State foundation supporting exports and foreign investment.

name: State Support Council for Non-Governmental Organizations under the President
description: State body providing financial and organizational support to NGOs.

name: Azerbaijani Armed Forces
description: Military forces of Azerbaijan, comprising the Land Forces, Air Force and Navy, subordinated to the Ministry of Defence.

name: Azerbaijani Land Forces
description: Land force branch of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces.

name: Azerbaijani Air Force
description: Air force branch of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces.

name: Azerbaijani Navy
description: Naval component of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces, operating in the Caspian Sea.

name: State Security Service of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Principal domestic security and counter-intelligence service (DTX), formed 2015 from the Ministry of National Security.

name: Foreign Intelligence Service of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: External intelligence agency of Azerbaijan (XQX), formed 2015.

name: State Border Service of Azerbaijan
description: Azerbaijani border security agency, responsible for guarding state borders and the Caspian coast.

name: Internal Troops of Azerbaijan
description: Gendarmerie branch (DQ) operating under the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

name: Special State Protection Service of Azerbaijan
description: State service responsible for protection of senior officials and key state facilities (DMX).

name: State Service of Special Communication and Information Security of Azerbaijan
aliases: Xüsusi Rabitə və İnformasiya Təhlükəsizliyi Dövlət Xidməti
description: State service responsible for government special communications and information/cyber security.

name: Azersilah
description: State defense industry company of Azerbaijan (weapons industry), integrated into the defense sector.

name: Military Prosecutor's Office of Azerbaijan
description: Military prosecution body within the prosecutor system.

name: SOCAR (State Oil Company of the Republic of Azerbaijan)
description: Fully state-owned national oil and gas company headquartered in Baku; the largest company in Azerbaijan (~70,000 employees per Wikidata).

name: Azerbaijan Airlines (AZAL)
description: Flag carrier and largest airline of Azerbaijan, state-owned.

name: Azerbaijan Railways (ADY)
description: National railway company of Azerbaijan, state closed joint-stock company.

name: Azercosmos
description: Satellite operator based in Azerbaijan, operating communications and Earth-observation satellites.

name: Azerenergy
description: State electric power generation and transmission company of Azerbaijan.

name: Azersu
description: Open joint-stock company for water supply and sanitation.

name: Azerishiq
description: Open joint-stock company for electricity distribution.

name: Azerbaijan Caspian Shipping Company (ASCO)
description: Caspian Sea shipping company (~9,000 employees per Wikidata), one of the oldest shipping companies (origins 1858).

name: Port of Baku (Baku International Sea Trade Port)
description: Main Caspian seaport of Azerbaijan at Alat, hub of the Trans-Caspian (Middle Corridor) route.

name: AzerGold
description: State company for exploration and production of precious metals (gold).

name: Azercell
description: State-affiliated mobile operator (founded 1996), part of the Azercell Telecom consortium.

name: Baku Metro
description: Rapid transit system operator of Baku (opened 1940).

name: Azərpoçt (Azerpost)
description: National postal operator of Azerbaijan.

name: AzInTelecom
description: State telecom company under the Ministry of Digital Development; operator of state data centers/cloud services.

name: Bakcell
description: First mobile operator of Azerbaijan (founded 1994), private mobile network.

name: Nar (Azerfon)
description: Private mobile operator in Azerbaijan (brand Nar).

name: AzerTelecom
description: National telecom operator and internet backbone provider (trans-Caspian fiber projects).

name: Azersun Holding
description: Azerbaijani food and agriculture conglomerate (tea, sugar, sunflower oil).

name: Veyseloglu Group of Companies

name: Gilan Holding
description: Azerbaijani diversified holding company (construction, food, tourism, media).

name: PASHA Holding

name: Azpetrol

name: Akkord Industry Construction Investment Corporation
description: Major Azerbaijani construction and industrial manufacturing corporation.

name: Baku Shipyard

name: Azerbaijan International Operating Company (AIOC)
description: International consortium (BP-operated) developing the Azeri-Chirag-Gunashli oil fields since 1994.

name: Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Monetary authority of Azerbaijan, issuer of the manat and banking regulator.

name: Bank ABB (International Bank of Azerbaijan)
description: Largest bank of Azerbaijan by assets and the only major state-owned bank; universal bank (66 branches).

name: State Oil Fund of the Republic of Azerbaijan (SOFAZ)
description: Sovereign wealth fund managing Azerbaijan's oil and gas revenues.

name: Baku Stock Exchange
description: Principal stock exchange of Azerbaijan.

name: Kapital Bank
description: One of the largest banks in Azerbaijan; part of PASHA Holding.

name: PASHA Bank
description: Corporate banking group founded 2007, part of PASHA Holding (Wikidata entity carries the Georgian subsidiary's HQ).

name: Unibank

name: Bank Respublika
description: Commercial bank founded 1992.

name: Bank of Baku
description: Commercial bank founded 1994.

name: XalqBank

name: TuranBank

name: Yelo Bank

name: Bank Melli Iran Baku Branch

name: Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences (ANAS)
description: The main state research organization of Azerbaijan, operating dozens of institutes.

name: Baku State University

name: ADA University

name: Azerbaijan Technical University

name: Azerbaijan University of Languages

name: Azerbaijan University of Architecture and Construction
description: University of architecture and civil engineering, founded 1930.

name: Azerbaijan State Agricultural University
description: Agricultural university in Ganja, founded 1929.

name: Baku Slavic University
description: University focused on Slavic studies, founded 1946.

name: Baku Academy of Music
description: Uzeyir Hajibeyli Baku Academy of Music, founded 1920.

name: Khazar University

name: Sumqayit State University

name: Ganja State University
description: State university in Ganja, founded 1938.

name: Nakhchivan State University
description: State university of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, founded 1967.

name: Azerbaijan State Pedagogical University
description: Teacher-training university founded 1921.

name: Baku Higher Oil School
description: Specialized higher school founded 2011 under SOCAR.

name: French-Azerbaijani University (UFAZ)

name: Academy of Public Administration under the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Presidential academy training civil servants, founded 1999.

name: Institute of Manuscripts of Azerbaijan (ANAS)

name: Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics (ANAS)
description: ANAS research institute for mathematics and mechanics, founded 1959.

name: Turan Information Agency

name: GUAM Organization for Democracy and Economic Development

description: Eurasian political and economic intergovernmental organization; Azerbaijan is a member.

name: Azerbaijani Popular Front Party

name: Civic Solidarity Party
description: Pro-government party founded 1992; part of the ruling coalition.

name: Motherland Party
description: National-conservative party founded 1990, led by Fazail Agamali; coalition partner of the government.

name: Azerbaijan Social Democratic Party
description: Social democratic party founded 1989 (one of the first registered parties).

name: Azerbaijan National Independence Party
description: Conservative opposition party founded 1992.

name: Islamic Party of Azerbaijan
description: Shia-oriented party founded 1991; banned by court decision in 2023 (leader Movsum Samadov imprisoned since 2012).

name: Classical Popular Front Party
description: Conservative opposition party (2006 split from the Popular Front), led by Mirmahmud Miralioglu.

name: Azerbaijan Hope Party
description: Party founded 1993, led by Igbal Agazade.

name: Party for Democratic Reforms
description: Liberal party founded 2005, led by Asim Mollazade.
